findingDetails.title: The removal block deletes the branch without the branch-tip condition its operator approved
findingDetails.evidence: goal.md:166 lists four pre-approval conditions including no commit beyond BASE_REF; the block checks RUNS_RECORDED, EMPTY and UNPATCHED plus PATCH_GATE_COVERED, then runs worktree remove --force and branch -D with no tip comparison.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a BASE_REF tip comparison that prints REMOVAL_REFUSED before the destructive pair, and use branch -d so git enforces the same condition.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Pre-approval row and the full T016 block read directly; rev-list, merge-base and BASE_REF were searched across the block and appear only in the sourced env.

claimAdjudication.claim: The T016 removal block executes branch -D without checking the branch tip against BASE_REF, though the operator pre-approval requires that check.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Searched the whole block for rev-list, merge-base, BASE_REF and any conditional guard around the two destructive commands; found none.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The tip check may have been performed manually before the block ran. Rejected as a control: a manual check leaves no artifact the script can read, and the block still executes -D unattended.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: A tip check found in a sourced file the block runs before the delete, or a recorded refusal path for a moved branch.

findingDetails.title: Scenario 483 runs a gate-disabled writer in dangerous mode and never checks containment
findingDetails.evidence: The dispatch disables the framework gate and permissions, the only bound is a prose ban list, and the Pass criteria check the packet, validation, token count and cleanup only - no path-scoped containment check exists.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a status or out-of-scope comparison against the run boundary to step 3 and to the Pass criteria, reusing the benchmark's out_of_scope_writes measure.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Dispatch line, brief ban list, all four steps and the Pass/Fail block read end to end; no git status or scoped diff appears in the procedure.

claimAdjudication.claim: Scenario 483's procedure and Pass criteria contain no containment check after a dangerous-mode, gate-disabled writer run.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Read all four steps and the Failure Triage paragraph for any status, diff or path check; the triage only re-runs the scenario.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: Containment might be assumed from the CLI's own workspace scoping. Rejected: the same line passes --permission-mode dangerous, and the packet's benchmark records out_of_scope_writes precisely because the CLI does not bound the writer.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: A containment step found in the scenario file or in the phase 008 wrapper that runs it, graded PASS with the run.

findingDetails.title: The acceptance evidence for the removal row was assembled by hand, not produced by the command it cites
findingDetails.evidence: AC-009 states that SCRATCH_CLEAN, PATCH_SAVED and STATUS_SAVED were prepended from console output because the block prints them outside its tee; the tee boundary at tasks.md:874 starts after those echoes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Wrap the whole block in the tee, or add the missing echoes inside the redirected group, then re-record the row from a real run.
findingDetails.scopeProof: AC row observed text and the block tee boundary both read; the three lines sit before the redirect.
